_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles, rendered at about 74px. Following the rule in CLAUDE.md: one bold centered object per prompt, static or a single simple contact, no cutaways and no convergence. The seven silhouettes are pulled apart deliberately: a stepped terraced pit, a timbered portal in a hillside, a wellhead on a pad, a jaw crusher with its V-shaped mouth, a bank of spiral chutes, a squat furnace with a tapping spout, and a flat-topped stack with benched sides.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red, yellow or green anywhere, even where the real object would be that color. No fire, no glow, no smoke. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: A stepped open-pit excavation cut into a flat plain, seen three-quarter from above: a wide circular hollow made of five or six concentric terraced benches descending to a small flat floor, with one narrow ramp spiraling down the inside wall. Just the pit shape in the ground, empty of equipment. No trucks, no machines, no buildings, no water in the bottom.
partPrompts.2: A mine portal set into the base of a low hillside, seen three-quarter: a square timbered opening framed by heavy posts and a lintel, with a short pair of narrow-gauge rails running out of the dark opening and ending on the flat ground in front. The hill is a simple rounded mound. One portal, no carts, no people, no headframe, no trees.
partPrompts.3: A single wellhead standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a short vertical pipe rising from a small square concrete pad, capped by a plain valve body with two horizontal side outlets and a round handwheel on top. Compact and industrial. One wellhead, no pipelines running away, no tanks, no derrick, no ground detail.
partPrompts.4: A jaw crusher standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a heavy rectangular steel frame whose top opening is a wide V-shaped mouth formed by one fixed and one sloping plate, with a large flywheel on the near side and a discharge opening at the bottom. The V-shaped mouth and the big flywheel are the identifying features. One machine, no conveyor, no rock, no feed hopper above it.
partPrompts.5: A bank of three spiral concentrators standing side by side on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: each is a tall vertical column wrapped by a continuous helical open trough that descends around it in five or six turns, with a small collection box at the bottom. The repeating helical ribbon is the identifying shape. Three columns only, no slurry, no piping, no frame around them.
partPrompts.6: A squat industrial furnace standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a heavy cylindrical vessel wider than it is tall on four short legs, with a short angled tapping spout projecting from the lower side and a plain vertical offtake pipe rising from the top. Exterior view only. No fire, no glow, no molten metal, no ladle, no building.
partPrompts.7: A flat-topped engineered stack of material standing alone on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a broad trapezoidal mound with three or four clearly stepped benches on its sloping sides and a completely flat level top, with clean straight edges as if built and compacted in lifts. One stack, no machinery, no water, no vegetation, no fence.
